pages.text: Comb one wool block to obtain two combed wool. Hold wool in offhand and comb in main hand, then use. Four combed wool on a felting board gives two felt after ten seconds.
Hide frame: insert leather and collect prepared hide after ten seconds. Drying rack: charged wet cloth dries in 30 seconds. Collect completed batches with empty hand.
Repair: bone needle in main hand, damaged Thermal armor in offhand and one thread in inventory. Right-click restores up to one quarter of maximum durability.
